collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: An older child accidentally knocks over a younger child's sandcastle while running past.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), an older child, accidentally knocks over a younger child's sandcastle while running past.

choices.label: Build a Wall to Protect the New One.
Ask How the Younger Child Wants It Built.
Offer to Fetch Water for a Moat.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The younger child needs a moment to stop crying before accepting help.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The wall becomes a game, and other children join in.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The younger child directs, and the older one happily follows.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The younger child wants to build alone, and the older one respects that.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The moat is a huge success.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The moat floods the castle, and both children dissolve into giggles.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The castle grows bigger than before, and both children laugh.
